# Shunsuke Kitada — shunk031.me

> Personal website of Shunsuke Kitada (北田 俊輔), Ph.D., a research scientist at LY Corporation. This site covers his research, publications, talks, projects, and technical writing.

Research interests include natural language processing, computer vision, medical image processing, and computational advertising.

## About

- [Homepage](https://shunk031.me/): Biography, recent news, research highlights, experience, and projects.
- [Researcher profile](https://shunk031.me/authors/shunsuke-kitada/): Affiliations, background, and research interests.

## Research

- [Publications](https://shunk031.me/publication/): Journal articles, conference papers, preprints, and theses, with links to papers and other materials where available.
- [Projects](https://shunk031.me/#projects): Research projects, posters, and official implementations featured on the homepage.
- [Talks](https://shunk031.me/event/): Research presentations and talks, including links to slides where available.

## News and writing

- [Recent news](https://shunk031.me/#recent-news): Research updates, awards, and other announcements.
- [Posts](https://shunk031.me/post/): Technical articles, conference reports, and other writing.
